ideas.title: Colouring canvas evening
ideas.description: Pick a 40 x 50 cm adult colouring canvas, buy snacks for each other, and spend two hours finishing the first section together.
ideas.materials: Canvas, fine-tip markers or pencils, snacks

ideas.title: Dessert café swap
ideas.description: Visit a dessert café neither of you has tried, with a shared AED 100 budget. Each of you orders one item for the other.

ideas.title: Playlist walk
ideas.description: Each of you builds a five-song playlist before the date. Swap them during an evening walk and explain one song choice each.

ideas.title: Cook-along on a call
ideas.description: Choose one recipe, buy the same ingredients in your own cities, and cook it at the same time on a video call. Eat together when it's done.

ideas.title: Sunrise and a flask of coffee
ideas.description: Find a spot facing east, arrive ten minutes before sunrise with coffee in a flask, and stay until the sky turns fully blue.

ideas.title: Three favourites at a museum
ideas.description: Walk a museum separately for 30 minutes, each choosing your three favourite pieces, then show each other your picks.

ideas.title: Same film, same moment
ideas.description: Pick a film, press play at the same second on a call, and pause halfway for a five-minute snack break to talk about it.
ideas.materials: A streaming service you both have

ideas.title: AED 50 market challenge
ideas.description: Each of you gets AED 50 at a market or souk. Meet back after 30 minutes and present what you bought for the other.

ideas.title: Simple picnic lunch
ideas.description: Pack sandwiches, fruit and a card game, find shade in a park, and stay offline for the first hour.
ideas.materials: Blanket, food, a deck of cards

ideas.title: Pottery taster class
ideas.description: Book a beginner pottery or wheel-throwing session and make one piece each to give to the other.

ideas.title: Stargazing outside the city
ideas.description: Drive out of the city lights after dark, bring a star-map app and warm drinks, and find three constellations.

ideas.title: Old Dubai by abra
ideas.description: Cross the creek by abra, walk the spice and textile souks, and stop for karak on the way back.

ideas.title: 1,000-piece puzzle night
ideas.description: Start a 1,000-piece puzzle with the edges first. Agree to stop at midnight even if it isn't finished.
ideas.materials: A puzzle and a table you can leave it on

ideas.title: One-colour photo walk
ideas.description: Pick one colour, walk a neighbourhood for an hour, and each take ten photos where that colour stars. Choose your best three together.

ideas.title: Make-each-other-a-quiz call
ideas.description: Each of you writes a ten-question quiz about yourself. Swap on a call and see who scores higher.

ideas.title: Long breakfast somewhere new
ideas.description: Try a breakfast place you haven't been to, order to share, and keep phones in your bags until the coffee arrives.

ideas.title: Two-person bake-off
ideas.description: Bake the same simple cake from one recipe, each decorating half your own way. Swap halves to taste.

ideas.title: Bookshop gift pick
ideas.description: Go to a bookshop with AED 80 each, choose a book for the other in 20 minutes, and write a short note inside the cover.

ideas.title: Virtual museum tour
ideas.description: Pick a museum with an online tour, share your screen, and each choose one room to guide the other through.

ideas.title: Beach walk at golden hour
ideas.description: Walk the beach in the hour before sunset, collect three small shells or stones each, and pick one to keep.

ideas.title: Cooking class for two
ideas.description: Book a class in a cuisine neither of you cooks, and recreate the best dish at home within a month.

ideas.title: Kayaking at sunrise
ideas.description: Rent a double kayak for an hour and paddle through the mangroves before it gets hot.

ideas.title: Board-game café
ideas.description: Spend two hours at a board-game café and try one game neither of you knows.

ideas.title: One scrapbook page
ideas.description: Print six photos from the last three months and build one scrapbook page together, with a caption for each photo.
ideas.materials: Printed photos, glue, pens, a notebook

ideas.title: Draw-blind on a call
ideas.description: Take turns describing a simple picture while the other draws it without seeing it. Compare at the end.

ideas.title: Night food crawl
ideas.description: Pick three food stalls, share one small dish at each, and rate them out of ten on a napkin.

ideas.title: Pick a plant together
ideas.description: Visit a plant nursery, choose one easy plant for your future home, and give it a name on the drive back.

ideas.title: Home cinema setup
ideas.description: Turn off the lights, make popcorn two ways, and watch a film one of you has loved since childhood.

ideas.title: Breakfast on a call
ideas.description: Set an alarm for the same morning, make breakfast at the same time, and eat together on a video call before work.

ideas.title: Bowling and milkshakes
ideas.description: Play two games of bowling, then share a milkshake where the loser of the second game chooses the flavour.

ideas.title: Volunteer morning
ideas.description: Sign up for a morning at a food bank, animal shelter or beach clean-up, then have lunch together afterwards.

ideas.title: A recipe from home
ideas.description: Ask a parent for a family recipe, cook it together, and call them afterwards to report how it went.

ideas.title: Read-aloud letters
ideas.description: Each write a short letter beforehand and read it aloud to the other on a call, with no replies until both have read.

ideas.title: Waterfront cycle
ideas.description: Rent bikes for an hour along a waterfront path and stop halfway for something cold to drink.

ideas.title: Aquarium visit
ideas.description: Go to an aquarium and each pick one creature you'd like to be for a day, and explain why over lunch.

ideas.title: Spice tasting at home
ideas.description: Buy five spices you rarely use, taste each on plain rice or bread, and pick one to cook with next week.
ideas.materials: Five spices, plain rice or bread

ideas.title: Dream-home tour call
ideas.description: Each search for one home online you'd love to live in, share screens and give a two-minute tour.

ideas.title: Furniture-store window shopping
ideas.description: Spend an hour in a furniture store, each choosing one item for your future living room, without buying anything.

ideas.title: Architecture walk
ideas.description: Visit a historic mosque or old district, read about its history beforehand, and take turns sharing one fact each.

ideas.title: Living-room karaoke
ideas.description: Make a shared karaoke queue of ten songs, five each, and sing them in turns with the lights low.
ideas.materials: A speaker and lyrics on screen

ideas.title: Online game night
ideas.description: Play two rounds of an online word or drawing game together on a call, best of three.

ideas.title: Ice skating
ideas.description: Go ice skating for an hour, then warm up with hot chocolate. Holding the wall is allowed.

ideas.title: Farmers' market breakfast
ideas.description: Walk a weekend farmers' market, buy breakfast ingredients, and cook them together at home.

ideas.title: Paint-along at home
ideas.description: Follow a beginner painting tutorial on a small canvas each, with mocktails, and hang both paintings for a week.
ideas.materials: Two small canvases, acrylic paint, brushes

ideas.title: Same sky on a call
ideas.description: Step outside at the same time in your two cities, find the moon or the brightest planet, and describe what you see.

ideas.title: Escape room
ideas.description: Book a beginner escape room for two and agree on one rule before starting: no blaming the other.

ideas.title: Tea in a garden
ideas.description: Find a café with a garden, try two teas you don't know, and decide which one goes in your future kitchen.

ideas.title: Memory-lane drive
ideas.description: Drive past three places that mean something to the two of you and share one memory at each stop.

ideas.title: Photo-booth strip
ideas.description: Find a photo booth or a mall photo printer, take a strip, and keep one copy each.

ideas.title: Plan a trip on a call
ideas.description: Pick a city you'd both like to visit and build a two-day itinerary on a shared document during one call.

ideas.title: Short hike to a view
ideas.description: Take a short marked trail to a viewpoint before sunset, with water and a snack to share at the top.

ideas.title: Mall scavenger hunt
ideas.description: Write five things to find for each other (something yellow, a funny sign...) and race to photograph them in 30 minutes.

ideas.title: Traditional sweets tour
ideas.description: Visit two traditional sweet shops, buy one piece each of something new, and pick a winner.

ideas.title: Read the same chapter
ideas.description: Pick a short book, read the same chapter during the week, and talk about it on a call.

ideas.title: AED 150 dinner for two
ideas.description: Plan a full dinner out for two within AED 150, including the drinks, and keep the receipt as a souvenir.

ideas.title: Rearrange one room
ideas.description: Spend an afternoon rearranging one room together, with a rule that each of you gets one veto.

ideas.title: Show and tell call
ideas.description: Each bring three objects from your room to a call and tell the story behind each one.

ideas.title: Short boat trip
ideas.description: Take a 45-minute public boat or ferry ride and watch the skyline from the water.

ideas.title: Make your own scent
ideas.description: Book a perfume or oud blending workshop and make a scent for each other.

ideas.title: Karak and stories
ideas.description: Make karak at home from scratch, and each tell the other a story from childhood they haven't heard yet.

ideas.title: Workout on a call
ideas.description: Follow the same 20-minute home workout video together on a call, then stretch and catch up.

ideas.title: Candlelit home dinner
ideas.description: Cook one main dish together, turn the lights down, and put both phones in another room until dessert.
